db:select.doc:name: Search Customers
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, city, sf_account_id FROM customers WHERE (:city = '' OR LOWER(city) = LOWER(:cityValue)) AND (:lastName = '' OR LOWER(last_name) = LOWER(:lastNameValue)) AND (:email = '' OR email = LOWER(:emailValue)) ORDER BY last_name, first_name LIMIT 100
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ city: attributes.queryParams.city default "", cityValue: attributes.queryParams.city default "", lastName: attributes.queryParams.lastName default "", lastNameValue: attributes.queryParams.lastName default "", email: attributes.queryParams.email default "", emailValue: attributes.queryParams.email default "" }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java import toCustomer from modules::CustomerMapping output application/json --- payload map ((row) -> toCustomer(row))
%dw 2.0 import toCustomer from modules::CustomerMapping output application/json --- toCustomer(payload[0])

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { id: "C" ++ (uuid()[0 to 7]), firstName: trim(payload.firstName), lastName: trim(payload.lastName), email: lower(trim(payload.email)), phone: trim(payload.phone default ""), city: trim(payload.city default ""), sfAccountId: null }

db:select.doc:name: Find by Email
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE email = :email

raise-error.doc:name: Duplicate Customer
raise-error.description: #['A customer with email ' ++ vars.customer.email ++ ' already exists']

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Customer
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customers (id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, city) VALUES (:id, :firstName, :lastName, :email, :phone, :city)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: vars.customer.id, firstName: vars.customer.firstName, lastName: vars.customer.lastName, email: vars.customer.email, phone: vars.customer.phone, city: vars.customer.city }]

logger.doc:name: Log CUSTOMER_CREATED
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- {event: 'CUSTOMER_CREATED', customerId: vars.customer.id, correlationId: correlationId}]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { id: vars.customerId, firstName: trim(vars.requestBody.firstName), lastName: trim(vars.requestBody.lastName), email: lower(trim(vars.requestBody.email)), phone: trim(vars.requestBody.phone default ""), city: trim(vars.requestBody.city default ""), sfAccountId: payload[0].sf_account_id }

db:select.doc:name: Email used by another customer?
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE email = :email AND id <> :id

raise-error.doc:name: Duplicate Customer
raise-error.description: #['A customer with email ' ++ vars.customer.email ++ ' already exists']

db:update.doc:name: Update Customer
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE customers SET first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, email = :email, phone = :phone, city = :city WHERE id = :id
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: vars.customer.id, firstName: vars.customer.firstName lastName: vars.customer.lastName, email: vars.customer.email, phone: vars.customer.phone, city: vars.customer.city }]

logger.doc:name: Log CUSTOMER_UPDATED
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- {event: 'CUSTOMER_UPDATED', customerId: vars.customer.id, correlationId: correlationId}]

logger.doc:name: Log CUSTOMER_DELETED
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- {event: 'CUSTOMER_DELETED', customerId: vars.customerId, correlationId: correlationId}]
